text:
Ava (Content): Hey team — the product launch post draft is up for final review. Main asks: tighten the benchmark narrative to be crystal-clear, confirm primary CTA (demo vs webinar), and map lead routing/UTMs. Draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/draft-v3 — aiming to publish Tue 4/20 10am PT.
Priya (PM): Thanks Ava. I'll do a content pass tonight. Two quick things: 1) open paragraph needs a sharper econ claim (latency/cost wins); 2) recommend primary CTA = demo booking, secondary = webinar.
Sam (Growth): Agree on demo as primary. We'll route demo leads to sales queue and webinar to marketing nurture. @Ava @Kevin tagging for UTM & lead fields.
Kevin (Analytics): For UTMs please use this template: `?utm_source=redwood_blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_v3&utm_content=demo_cta` Also add a hidden form field `product_interest=dedicated` so we can auto-segment in CRM.
Jordan (Design): I'll provide two hero variants in Figma (A: screenshot + stat, B: motion with brief). Leaning A for the benchmark-led narrative. I'll drop assets tomorrow morning. :art:
Ava (Content): Perfect. Can we also shorten the benchmark section into 3 punchy bullets and add a mini-chart? Who can make a quick chart mock?
Jordan (Design): I can mock a simple sparkline + single stat card. Need the exact numbers — @Kevin, can you export the latency/cost data?
Kevin (Analytics): Yep. I'll export latency p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens by model variant and drop a CSV into the doc by EOD.
Lee (Legal): Quick legal note: avoid naming customers or exact revenue figures without signoff. Use ranges (e.g., "~20–40%") or relative improvements. Also watch for claims like "cheaper than X" unless we have a public benchmark.
Sam (Growth): Noted. For lead routing: demo form -> `sales-demo` queue; webinar form -> `marketing-webinar` list. I'll configure HubSpot to tag source=blog and pass `product_interest`. Will share mapping snippet.
Ava (Content): Great — timeline check: please get design + analytics numbers in by Mon EOD (4/19) so I can fold changes and request final sign-off.
Priya (PM): I'll approve content changes once benchmark bullets are tightened. If legal is clear, we should be good to go.
Lee (Legal): I'll review any language edits before final publish. Should be quick if numbers are ranges.
Jordan (Design): Assets will be in Figma by 11am PT tomorrow.
Kevin (Analytics): CSV uploaded at 18:00 PT today.
Sam (Growth): HubSpot field mapping posted. Also proposing a short nurture flow for webinar registrants (2 emails, one reminder).
Ava (Content): Thanks all — I'll incorporate, update the doc, and ping for final sign-off. Publishing target still Tue 4/20 10am PT. :calendar:
